_note: Model registry. A model owns its URL (/<category>/<slug>); every configuration (offer) of a model shares its photos, blurb and tags. `slug` is frozen once published. `status`: in_catalog | sourceable | retired (a retired model keeps its page). `tags` are typed (see taxonomy.json) and set on the model, never on an offer; price_band is derived from offer prices at build. `categoryId` is the legacy importer category, kept for the supplier-sheet pipeline. sheetAliases are "Brand | Model" exactly as written in supplier sheets.
